sources.notes: solent.cas-shield.com resolves (HTTP 200) and serves Enroly's CAS Shield login page (page text contains 'Enroly' and 'CAS Shield'), so Solent University uses Enroly CAS Shield for its CAS process. Enroly pre-CAS interviews draw randomised questions from themed banks; no question list is published on the site.
